points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable f679644 build succeeded with documented CMake external roots inside network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3GiB/256 pids. No CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: f679644 main.cpp:142–155 accepts --restart but never uses restart_file; solver.run initializes freestream. restart_final.vtk is identical to field_final.vtk, with no source reader; its field contents exist, so it is not claimed to be an empty placeholder.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, partition, flux, viscous, reconstruction, implicit and output, but main.cpp contains unfinished development commentary and fixed 2D state.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No external solver executable or copied core directly established in reviewed source; no exhaustive external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:35–44 selects mesh from case JSON rather than only two filenames; output.cpp:247–249 fixes timestamps and success flag, and solver.cpp:356 hardcodes zero moment.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:179–229 keeps a full GlobalMesh on every rank during solver.run; this violates TASK prohibited shortcut 7. METIS partition and neighbor communication are present. Production-source binding is unresolved.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:415–422 caps steady CFL at5, :459–464 applies density and pressure fallback; status is unconditionally successful at :712–715 despite selected failed results.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Previous structural validator results are recorded; independent clean build passed. Selected Re200 iteration metadata conflicts with its unchanged residual history and no unsteady run was repeated.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: main.cpp:213–225 retains development comments; metadata uses fixed 2024 timestamps and output moment is always zero. Historical result packages require separate provenance.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
